_note: Guided tutorial steps (campaign/tutorial.gd reads this; ui/tutorial_overlay.gd draws it). Each step: id, anchor (a Control name, a tutorial_anchor meta value, or a node path from the overlay's host), one short line of text, and done: what counts as done. done kinds: next (press Next), button (press the anchored button; done.anchor defaults to the step anchor), screen (a screen opens: done.screen is a Game screen name), state (a host state key reaches done.equals). v0.103 ships this short Settings-anchored sample so Replay tutorial works today; v0.104 replaces it with chapter one and adds anchors on the campaign screens.

steps.text: Welcome. This tutorial highlights one control at a time and waits until you use it. Press Next to continue.
Settings take effect at once and are saved straight away. This switch turns automatic battle slow motion on or off.
That is the whole sample. You can replay the tutorial any time from Settings, and Skip tutorial ends it early.
